name: Transformation
overview: Transformation in Scripture is depicted as a profound renewal that begins with God creating a clean heart and renewing a right spirit within the believer (Psalms 51:10). It involves justification by faith through Jesus Christ, bringing peace with God (Romans 5:1), and calling believers to present themselves as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God (Romans 12:1). This transformation is marked by the renewing of the mind, enabling believers to discern and live according to God's perfect will (Romans 12:2), and is characterized by a life lived through faith in Christ who lives within (Galatians 2:20). Forgiveness is foundational to this change, as seen in the mercy extended through Christ's sacrifice, which enables true spiritual renewal.
